patentBag.inventionTitle: Streaming vector embedding pipeline with merkle commitment
patentBag.abstractText: A system for computing streaming vector embeddings of incoming event records and producing a merkle root over the event fields.

patentBag.inventionTitle: Subscriber interest matching using hybrid dense and sparse signals
patentBag.abstractText: Method for matching incoming events to subscriber profiles using both dense semantic embeddings and sparse Boolean trees.
